name: Jamilena (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of purple, yellow and purple with a broad yellow stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jamilena (a cross of Calatrava on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Jamilena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Jamilena arms — cross of Calatrava on yellow
cross of Calatrava of the arms
